notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes: minor bug fixes for local multiplayer with multiple Tilt Five Headsets

notes.title: SINGLE PLAYER + LOCAL MULTIPLAYER NOW AVAILABLE
notes.notes: Now supports single player + local multiplayer for Tilt Five users! Now you no longer have to wait for someone to connect with online in order to play. Embark on the journey alone in single player mode or connect multiple Tilt Five glasses to play with friends in local multiplayer mode!

notes.title: UPDATE AVAILABLE! SIGLE PLAYER + LOCAL TILT FIVE MULTIPLAYER!!
notes.notes: NOW SUPPORTING SINGLE PLAYER + LOCAL MULTIPLAYER (MULTIPLE GLASSES) FOR TILT FIVE USERS! You no longer have to wait for a friend to connect with online now you can embark on the journey alone or connect multiple Tilt Five glasses to play with your friends locally!

notes.title: Update Notes for March 14, 2023
notes.notes:
Updated Tilt Five SDK from version 1.3.0 to 1.3.1
Please make sure to update your Tilt Five Driver to 1.3.1 as well if playing on Tilt Five AR Gaming System.
